title: Deep Eddy Pool - Wikipedia
content: # Deep Eddy Pool. Historic public pool in Austin, Texas. | U.S. National Register of Historic Places |. **Deep Eddy Pool** is a historic man-made swimming pool in Austin, Texas. Deep Eddy is the oldest swimming pool in Texas and features a bathhouse built during the Depression era by the Works Progress Administration. The pool began as a swimming hole in the Colorado River "Colorado River (Texas)"), became a resort in the 1920s, and is today a popular swimming pool operated by the City of Austin. Deep Eddy began as a swimming hole located along the banks of the Colorado River which flows through Austin. The Works Progress Administration and the city of Austin jointly funded the building of a new bathhouse, which was designed by Austin architects Dan Driscoll and Delmar Groos. Deep Eddy Pool is listed as a historic landmark on the National Register of Historic Places and has been the inspiration of various works of art.
